$comment: The tools the e-invoice gate runs over the XML the runtime writes (0027), each fetched from its release's asset and refused unless its SHA-256 is the one here. Each hash and size was read from GitHub's digest of the asset and from a download of it, which agreed, on 17 October 2026 at 14:36 UTC. `java` is the oldest Java a JAR runs on, from its manifest's Build-Jdk-Spec and its classes' versions, read the same day; `runtime` is the Java CI runs the gate on, which must run every JAR, and `distribution` its name to actions/setup-java. `licence` is a tool's own. Each download carries other works under their own licences, which nobody here reviewed one by one -- Saxon in both JARs, veraPDF and CEN/TC 434's EUPL-1.2 schematron in Mustang's, the same schematron in the configuration: they run in CI and no package carries them (0027). Read by scripts/e-invoice.mjs; held by scripts/e-invoice/registers.test.mjs. A new release is adopted by changing all of its entry in one commit, with a CHANGELOG line saying why.
